big.definition: Above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent.

small.definition: Having little size or extent compared with something else.
small.exampleUsage: The small was identified during the lesson.

large.definition: Above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent.

tiny.definition: Extremely small in size compared with other things.

huge.definition: Unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope.

enormous.definition: Extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree.

miniature.definition: Being on a very small scale.

medium.definition: In the middle of a range of sizes or amounts.

wide.definition: Having a large width from one side to the other.

narrow.definition: Having a small width compared with its length.

close.definition: At or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other.

far-away.definition: A considerable distance separates two places that are well apart.

adjacent.definition: Near or close to but not necessarily touching.

nearby.definition: Not far away in relative terms.

remote.definition: Far away from a specified place or other places.

proximate.definition: Very close in space or time.

within-reach.definition: Close enough to be touched, taken, or reached easily.
within-reach.exampleUsage: Keep the notebook within reach on the desk.

out-of-reach.definition: Situated beyond someone's ability to reach or access.

arm-s-length.definition: A distance roughly equal to the length of a person's outstretched arm.
arm-s-length.exampleUsage: Hold the screen about an arm's length from your face.

high.definition: A lofty level or position or degree.

low.definition: Being at or having a relatively small elevation or upward extension.

short.definition: Having little length or height compared with something else.

deep.definition: Extending a long way down from the surface.

shallow.definition: Not extending far down from the surface.

elevated.definition: Raised above the surrounding ground or surface.

sunken.definition: Lower than the surrounding surface or pushed inward.

level.definition: Horizontal rather than sloping, in this surface-position sense.
level.exampleUsage: The level was used during the activity.

flat.definition: Having a surface that is not curved or uneven.

horizontal.definition: Parallel to or in the plane of the horizon or a base line.

vertical.definition: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line.

diagonal.definition: Slanting between horizontal and vertical directions in this arrangement.

parallel.definition: Being everywhere equidistant and not intersecting.

perpendicular.definition: Meeting or crossing another line or surface at a right angle.

aligned.definition: Placed in a straight line or correct position relative to something.

scattered.definition: Occurring or distributed over widely spaced and irregular intervals in time or space.

clustered.definition: Grouped close together in one area.

stacked.definition: Placed one above another in a pile.

layered.definition: With one layer on top of another.
